headline: Amazon shoppers are sharing screenshots of the sometimes blunt guesses its AI makes about them on the "About You" page.
score_reason: Pool score kept; light viral story with a real privacy and personalization angle.
importance_line: Amazon's customers can now see, and correct, what the company has inferred about them; the inferences are partly wrong, and the posts are self-selected funny examples.
summary: Business Insider reports that Amazon's "About You" page, a customer profile of preferences that Amazon's AI infers from shopping history, searches, reviews and Alexa conversations, is trending on social media for its blunt entries. Amazon launched the feature in May and lets users edit or delete what it shows, and Business Insider's own reporters found the results accurate in some cases and wrong in others.
notes: Feature launched in May 2026; the story is the new viral attention.
